# RateThatTennis

> Free machine-learning tennis predictions, player ratings and betting intelligence for ATP, WTA and Challenger tennis. Always free.

## What this site does

RateThatTennis (https://ratethat.tennis) provides:

- **ML win probability predictions** for upcoming ATP, WTA, Challenger and ITF matches
- **RTT player ratings** — a proprietary 0-100 composite rating across all surfaces, updated daily
- **Surface-specific ratings** for clay, hard, grass and indoor hard
- **Live bookmaker odds** with model edge calculation (our probability minus implied bookmaker probability)
- **Form analysis** — rolling 10-match performance index, quality-weighted
- **Head-to-head records** with surface breakdown
- **Betting systems tracking** — named systems (Surface Monster, Form Surge, etc.) with live P&L and ROI

## Match prediction methodology

Predictions are generated by an ensemble ML model trained on ~650,000 historical ATP and WTA matches (Jeff Sackmann dataset, 1968–present, full serve/return stats from 2000). The model combines XGBoost + LightGBM + Logistic Regression. Walk-forward backtest (2015–2024) shows ~68% accuracy, AUC ~0.76. Predictions are expressed as win probability percentages and are calibrated (not raw model outputs).

## Player ratings (RTT Score)

The RTT Score is a proprietary composite rating on a 0-100 scale, normalised across all active players, quality-weighted (wins against stronger opponents count more), surface-adjusted and time-decayed (recent matches weighted more). 13 rating dimensions include serve rating, return rating, pressure rating, consistency rating, and surface-specific scores.

## Coverage

- ATP (Grand Slams, Masters 1000, ATP 500, ATP 250)
- WTA (Grand Slams, WTA 1000, WTA 500, WTA 250)
- ATP Challenger series
- ITF Men's and Women's circuits
- Odds coverage via Bet365 and Unibet

## Data freshness

- Fixtures: refreshed at 06:00 and 18:00 UTC daily
- Live scores: updated every 5 minutes
- Odds: updated at 07:00 and 19:00 UTC daily
- Player ratings: recomputed daily at 01:00 UTC

## Usage

All data on ratethat.tennis is free to browse. No subscription required.
Predictions and ratings are for informational and entertainment purposes. Please gamble responsibly.
